slides.title: Rejection is data, not a verdict
slides.body: Every "no" tells you which round to fix: resume, test, or interview.

slides.title: Write down 3 questions after every interview
slides.body: The ones you struggled with. Those are next week's practice list.

slides.title: Practise out loud, not in your head
slides.body: Thinking an answer and saying it are different skills.

slides.title: Apply to 5 more today
slides.body: Momentum beats motivation. Small daily wins add up.
